layer_3_action.subject: Vibrant mid-day view of expansive floodplains
features: Endless flat horizon under a massive bright sky
A carpet of vibrant green low-lying ferns and ancient mosses
Scattered clusters of ginkgos and conifers providing rare verticality
Warm sunlight creating a golden glow over the vegetation
No grass; ground cover is entirely ancient spore-plants
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic, wide-angle landscape of an open, sunny floodplain. The ground is a soft-looking textured green carpet. The lighting is bright and cheerful.

visuals.ground: A rich, textured carpet of vibrant green bryophytes and low-growing ferns. No grass blades present. Soil is rich and dark where visible.
visuals.water: Distant glints of water from seasonal pools or slow-moving streams.
visuals.sky: Bright, saturated blue sky with high-altitude wispy clouds and a brilliant noon sun.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Spongy moss layers and the repeating patterns of feathery fern fronds.

negative_prompt: grass, lawns, prairies, cows, buildings, dark shadows, gloom, 90s CGI, grainy, humans
